decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:12pt;">The proposed single storey&nbsp;rear extension&nbsp;by reason of its excessive depth, width and siting in close proximity to No. 7&nbsp;Park Drive would give rise to overshadowing and an&nbsp; overbearing visual impact to the detriment of the residential and visual amenities of the occupiers of this neighbouring property. The proposal would therefore be contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D(1) and D(11)) of The London Plan (2021), policy CS1.B on the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Local Plans Policies (2013) and adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft Harrow Local Plan GR1.</span></p>

<p>The proposed single and two storey side extension together with the proposed hip to gable&nbsp;roof extension and rear dormer, by reason of their excessive combined width, bulk, massing and poor design would result in an incongruous, discordant, contrived, unduly bulky and dominant addition to the host dwelling and street scene, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the property and area. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 D.1, D.11, D.12 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM 1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft Harrow Local Plan GR1.</p>
description: Single and two storey side to rear extension,  Juliette balcony to first floor rear elevation, Single storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to form end gable and rear dormer with Juliette balcony, Roof lights on front roof slope, External alterations, Single storey detached outbuilding with canopy at rear for use as Gym/Games room
